draw_3d_keypoints: draw 3D keypoints from numpy arrays with configurable axis angles and keypoint threshold
draw_3d_data_samples: draw 3D pose data samples with ground truth and prediction keypoints on a matplotlib 3D axis
draw_instances_kpts: draw 2D instance keypoints and skeleton links on an image using mmpose or openpose style
add_datasample: add a pose data sample to the visualizer and save merged 2D and 3D visualization to file or backend
init_Pose3dLocalVisualizer: create a Pose3dLocalVisualizer instance with custom keypoint colors, skeleton definition, and detection dataset settings
